description: Unofficial Aku fan art inspired by Samurai Jack. A compact horned shapeshifter animates his flame-like brows, reshapes one hand into a harmless little shadow bird, smooths his red beard and calmly folds his arms. Original nine-state choreography uses two separated root-like feet as an openly adapted desktop gait. No attack targets, violence or official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
